title.en: An Act Prescribing the Rate of Interest to Be Paid By the Philippine National Bank on Deposits of the Insular Government and the Provincial and Municipal Governments.
title.orig: An Act Prescribing the Rate of Interest to Be Paid By the Philippine National Bank on Deposits of the Insular Government and the Provincial and Municipal Governments.

text.en:
The Philippine National Bank shall pay interest on deposits of the Insular Government and the
provincial and municipal governments at the following rates: two per centum on deposits in current account
and three and one-half per centum on fixed deposits.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 20, 1921.
